title: GCD / UMCP: The First Welded Seam Casepack — A Worked Case Showing Earned Continuity Under Frozen Seam Accounting
object_of_study: earned continuity across a declared seam
main_question: When does a finite-return event also satisfy the stronger burden required for welded continuity under frozen seam accounting?
